rows.counterargument: Accurate departure. Three days after the assassination, inside the sheet's ±3-day window. A four-month grounded stay ending after the event is also what a completed maintenance visit looks like.

ground_stay.notes: 113 CONTINUOUS DAYS on the Provo ramp - the longest published stay by any aircraft in this investigation, covering 10 September. Only local flights were flown during it: Provo-Provo on 10 Jun and a 1:08 Provo-Provo on 5 Sep. Audit: 'ACCURATE POSS BROKEN JET GROUNDED IN PROVO' and 'ONLY LOCAL FLIGHTS WERE FLOWN IN AND AROUND PROVO FROM 10 JUNE-13 SEPT.' Owens: transponder ON on 10 Sep but the aircraft DID NOT TAKE OFF. COUNTERARGUMENT: a four-month stay is a maintenance-visit length, not a surveillance-orbit length. THE OWENS SHEET'S 7 JUL 2025 'GOOSEBAY-PARIS-CAIRO' ROW IS ENTERED TWICE (index 37 and 66) AND BOTH ARE FALSE - the aircraft was here the whole time.
